description: Use Google's WASM text-to-speech voices locally through a supported Chromium browser runtime such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Brave as an NVDA synthesizer.
publisher: Nguyen Anh Duc <ducna1803@gmail.com>, Dao Duc Trung <trung@ddt.one> and Pham Hung Vuong <hungvuong106206@gmail.com>
changelog:
Version 0.6:
- Added an optional setting to make Google TTS ready faster when switching from another synthesizer. This setting is off by default; when turned on, it may use more memory while NVDA is running.
- When this setting is enabled, Google TTS updates its background preparation after you change the selected Chromium browser runtime or install/remove voice packages.
- Improved reliability when switching away from Google TTS, especially while speech or voice preparation is still stopping.
